We are using the Sjstats package: https://strengejacke.github.io/sjstats/reference/samplesize_mixed.html

# Load in Required Packages and Data
```{r}
library(sjstats)
library(pwr)
```

## Effect Size of 0.3
```{r}
samplesize_mixed(
  eff.size = 0.3,
  df.n = NULL,
  power = 0.8,
  sig.level = 0.05,
  k = 4, # Number of cluster groups (level-2-unit) in multilevel-design
  n = 4 # Optional, number of observations per cluster groups (level-2-unit)
  # in multilevel-design
)
```

## Effect Size of 0.5
```{r}
samplesize_mixed(
  eff.size = 0.5,
  df.n = NULL,
  power = 0.8,
  sig.level = 0.05,
  k = 4, # Number of cluster groups (level-2-unit) in multilevel-design
  n = 4 # Optional, number of observations per cluster groups (level-2-unit)
  # in multilevel-design
)
```
